verdict.rationale: Attio ships an official, extensively documented App SDK in TypeScript/React. It covers extensions such as record actions, tabs, widgets, pages and workflow blocks, plus server functions, a GraphQL data API, connections and webhook handlers. The docs say it was designed for AI-assisted development and bootstraps AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files in every new app. missing for 10: official general-purpose REST client libraries (e.g. Node/Python) beyond the in-Attio App SDK and the raw OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
